modified_workflow: 01 build_render: page sizes, portrait/landscape rules, fonts, drawing helpers, pageCompression and 150 DPI PNG rendering are unchanged; the builder iterates notices.json groups (5 pages per group), global page numbers and bookmark targets are computed over all groups
02 validate: dynamic validator reads frozen expected.json and checks every group's pages, facts, bookmarks and orientation

scale_metadata.scale_driven_by: frozen notices.json prepared material; the builder iterates every declared notice group through the real five-page drawing functions (no page duplication). The synthetic input PDF is an artifact only and is not read by the builder.

measurement_scope: Scales the number of frozen structured notice groups that drive actual ReportLab page construction, pypdf bookmark/metadata finalization and 150 DPI PNG rendering. 5 groups -> 25 pages, 20 groups -> 100 pages. All units enter the build functions; pages are never duplicated from a 5-page base.
